summary: PodFetch is a self-hosted podcast manager (Rust/axum/Diesel) with a multi-user account model (users/sessions/invites, sha256 passwords, admin/uploader/user roles), podcast subscription + episode download engine (podcasts/podcast_episodes/subscriptions/favorites), a gpodder.net-compatible sync API (devices/episodes-action-log/subscriptions), playlists, per-user listening stats (listening_events), per-user tags/filters/settings, transcript/chapter/sponsorblock/triage subsystems, and an optional Audiobookshelf-compatible surface (libraries/books/media-progress/playback-sessions) with auth via users.api_key.
